analysis.summary: Srivari Spices and Foods Limited reported FY25 revenue of INR 11,380 lakhs, driven by its core spices and atta segments. The company launched a new automated oil manufacturing facility in May 2025 and is introducing 'Poushtik,' a premium e-commerce grocery vertical. Management aims for geographic expansion into Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, and other states while maintaining a focus on high-quality, non-discounted products.

guidance.claim: The company expects capacity utilization to reach 90% plus across all three segments, including oil, this year.
guidance.quote: we are expecting this year, all our capacity utilization will be up to 90% plus in all the three segments, including oil.

guidance.claim: Management intends to maintain the growth commitments made in previous investor meetings.
guidance.quote: the growth driver will be -- we will maintain as per in our last conversation what we committed in this investor's meet.

demand_outlook.claim: Management observes a shift in the spices and atta markets from unorganized to organized trade.
demand_outlook.quote: As I said, one important thing is in the spices, still 70% is an unorganized trade. So, after the post COVID, now people are moving to the packaging and quality products.

demand_outlook.claim: The company is targeting a premium customer base through its Poushtik platform rather than competing on discounts.
demand_outlook.quote: We are focusing just only on the quality and we will advertise or in media wherever then, we will focus on the quality. We are not discount store.

demand_outlook.claim: The company expects a minimum cart value of INR 800 to INR 1,000 for the Poushtik platform.
demand_outlook.quote: our cart value will be more than INR900 to INR1,000 in between we are assuming that exactly as per our research, so it will be minimum of INR800 to INR1,000.

capex_expansion.claim: The company launched a new oil production plant and the Poushtik e-commerce division in 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: And most recently in 2025, we launched our new oil production plant, introduced a new vertical called Poushtik which focuses on nutritious rich food products aligned with our mission to bring health and tasty together.

capex_expansion.claim: The new oil plant is an automated, export-oriented unit located in Telangana.
capex_expansion.quote: It is a premium unit completely based out of export oriented unit. So, our focus is on all the oils which are into the double filter or cold press.

capex_expansion.claim: The company plans to expand into Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra, and Odisha.
capex_expansion.quote: now our growth will be from next focused states will be Karnataka and Tamil Nadu as well as Maharashtra and Odisha soon.

margins_costs.claim: The company is using electric vehicles for Poushtik deliveries to reduce operating costs.
margins_costs.quote: Second thing, we will be delivering the complete Poushtik with this electric. So it will reduce our operating cost for that.

orders_capacity.claim: The installed capacity for spices and masalas is 3,600 tons per annum, with 2,637 tons utilized.
orders_capacity.quote: For spices and masalas, we have an installed capacity of 3,600 tons per annum with the current utilization at about 2,637 tons.

orders_capacity.claim: The company utilized 12,650 tons of its 14,400 tons per annum installed capacity for atta.
orders_capacity.quote: When it comes to atta, 14,400 tons per annum installed capacity and we have utilized 12,650 tons.

orders_capacity.claim: The oil plant has an installed capacity of 7,200 tons per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: Regarding oil, we have installed capacity of 7,200 tons per annum but this plant is yet to be commercialized.

capital_allocation.claim: Rights issue funds were used for the oil plant, debt repayment, and working capital.
capital_allocation.quote: our main objects of the rights issue was to for the oil plant, which is around INR8.64 crores, sorry, 864.02 lakhs, that is INR8 crores 64 lakhs change and repayment of unsecured loans, which is about INR1.90 crores and for working capital requirement, it is around INR10 crores

capital_allocation.claim: The company has a bank facility of INR 12 crores which is currently fully utilized.
capital_allocation.quote: INR12 crores is a facility, INR200 lakhs is a facility with the banking. So we can move further. We can fund from the banking also.

risks_headwinds.claim: The cost of the oil unit setup increased due to higher-than-expected investment in infrastructure and civil work.
risks_headwinds.quote: delay was because of we have invested more into this infrastructure as it is a civil work was huge in this setup plant. So, it was increased by INR1 crores to INR1.5 crores of this as we expected in this.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects capacity utilization to reach 90% plus across all three segments, including oil.
management_commitments.quote: we are expecting this year, all our capacity utilization will be up to 90% plus in all the three segments, including oil.

management_commitments.claim: The company will launch the Poushtik application by the end of the month.
management_commitments.quote: The Poushtik we haven't launched yet. It is current, we are processing, soon it will be announced in this month end.

management_commitments.claim: The company is targeting 300 deliveries per day for the Poushtik platform within two quarters.
management_commitments.quote: within the six months of time frame, in the two quarters, we are targeting per day targeting deliveries of 300 deliveries.

management_commitments.claim: The company intends to start exporting products in the second half of the year.
management_commitments.quote: definitely we are the second, H2, we are going to start the export.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
